digest.component_or_area: rebar documentation remediation epic (docs + CI drift gates)
propositions: README session-log command syntax is invalid because it omits the append subcommand, and the quickstart is not a genuine end-to-end single ticket.
README and docs/config.md misstate the dependency count and mcp version floor (truth: 3 base deps, mcp>=1.9).
docs/output-schemas.md references a moved source path and describes a removed bash shell-out, with stale bash-engine language in CI comments and leaf.py.
docs/README.md index is incomplete (unlinked living docs) and mixes living references with historical evidence.
A CI gate must extract and execute the literal README quickstart fenced command block so wrong printed command text fails the build.
A docs-index CI gate must fail the build when living docs are unlinked or managed relative links to docs/archive/ do not resolve, and CLI/MCP references must drift-gate against live registries.
